name: lu_unpack_out
description: Representative ATen schema: aten::lu_unpack.out(Tensor LU_data, Tensor LU_pivots, bool unpack_data=True, bool unpack_pivots=True, *, Tensor(a!) P, Tensor(b!) L, Tensor(c!) U) -> (Tensor(a!) P, Tensor(b!) L, Tensor(c!) U). Writes the unpacked permutation, lower-triangular and upper-triangular factors into caller-provided buffers. Coverage validates returned object identity, output resize, accepted floating casts, noncontiguous storage and stride preservation, and rejected integral outputs. LU_data and LU_pivots are not mutated; P, L and U are mutated and returned as their corresponding aliases.
